# RepoSentinel Support / Bantuan RepoSentinel

## English

For usage questions, configuration help, reproducible bugs, or feature ideas, open the appropriate public Issue template. Include the RepoSentinel version, Node.js version, operating system, command shape, profile, report format, and a sanitized reproduction. Do not include credentials, private keys, personal data, proprietary source, unredacted reports, or private repository URLs.

Start with the [README](../README.md), [CLI case examples](../docs/RepoSentinel_CLI_Case_Examples.md), and [rule catalog](../docs/RULES.md). Use `reposentinel --help`, `reposentinel rules`, and `reposentinel explain <ruleId>` to inspect the stable CLI contract locally.

For a suspected vulnerability, secret exposure, path escape, arbitrary code execution, or accidental network access, do not open a public Issue. Follow the private disclosure process in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Security reports should contain only the minimum sanitized evidence needed for triage.

Support is best-effort. A readiness score is not a security certification, and a clean scan does not guarantee that a repository contains no vulnerabilities or secrets.

## Bahasa Indonesia

Untuk pertanyaan penggunaan, bantuan konfigurasi, bug yang dapat direproduksi, atau ide fitur, buka Issue publik menggunakan template yang sesuai. Sertakan version RepoSentinel, version Node.js, operating system, bentuk command, profile, report format, dan reproduction yang sudah disanitasi. Jangan menyertakan credential, private key, personal data, proprietary source, report yang belum di-redact, atau private repository URL.

Mulai dari [README](../README.md), [contoh CLI](../docs/RepoSentinel_CLI_Case_Examples.md), dan [rule catalog](../docs/RULES.md). Gunakan `reposentinel --help`, `reposentinel rules`, dan `reposentinel explain <ruleId>` untuk melihat kontrak CLI stable secara lokal.

Untuk dugaan vulnerability, secret exposure, path escape, arbitrary code execution, atau network access yang tidak disengaja, jangan membuka Issue publik. Ikuti proses private disclosure di [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Security report hanya boleh berisi evidence minimum yang sudah disanitasi untuk kebutuhan triage.

Support bersifat best-effort. Readiness score bukan security certification, dan scan yang bersih bukan jaminan bahwa repository bebas vulnerability atau secret.
